observation_summary: The compiler failed to report a syntax error when encountering an invalid unnamed function statement.
reasoning_summary: The parser failed to enforce the language specification that requires function statements to have a name. While unnamed function expressions are valid in JavaScript, unnamed function statements are not. The fix introduces a check in the IRFactory to verify if a function node is a function expression; if it is not (meaning it is a statement) and lacks a name, it now correctly triggers a parse error.
